FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!
A mere child like you dares to challenge me?
The very idea makes me shiver with mirth!
Very well, I shall show you true terror as a ninja master.
Poison brings steady doom. Sleep renders foes helpless.
Despair to the creeping horror of POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat:
Humph! You have proven your worth!
Here! Take the SOULBADGE!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle:
When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON suffers more and more.
It suffers worsening damage as the battle wears on!
It will surely terrorize foes!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadg:
Now that you have the SOULBADGE, the DEFENSE of your POKéMON rises.
It also lets you SURF outside of battle.
Ah! Take this, too!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06:
Sealed within that TM06 lies TOXIC!
It is a secret technique dating back some four hundred years.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro:
Strength isn't the key for POKéMON. Do you understand this?
POKéMON is about strategy!
I'll show you how strategy can beat brute strength.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle:
So, you mix brawn with brains? Good strategy!
That's remarkable for a child TRAINER.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro:
I was a magician once upon a time.
But I dreamt of becoming a ninja, so I joined this GYM.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle: Even though I've lost, I will keep training according to the teachings of KOGA, my ninja master.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro: Let's see you beat my special techniques!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle: I like poison and sleep techniques, as they linger after battle!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro:
Stop right there!
The famed invisible walls of FUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle:
You impressed me! Here's a hint!
Look very closely for gaps in the invisible walls!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro:
I also study the way of the ninja with Master KOGA!
Ninja have a long history of using animals!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle: I still have much to learn.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro:
Master KOGA comes from a long line of ninjas.
What did you descend from?
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat: You're more skilled than I'd thought!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle:
Where there is light, there is shadow!
Light and shadow! Which do you choose?
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Yo! Champ in the making!
FUCHSIA GYM is a tricked-up place. It's riddled with invisible walls!
KOGA might appear close, but he's blocked off.
You have to find gaps in the walls to reach him.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory: It's amazing how ninja can terrify, even now!
